### Reuse populations: exceptions by time since the first request of the repetition (100 ms buckets with any request; `exceptions/requests`)

Per repetition (added after the run, descriptive): `M0` = the Redis second in which the returned `expiresAt` was written (creation for R / ROT-R, the previous key for ROT-P); the caller is behind by `s`, so a request throws while its L867 host time is below `M0 + s`. `f0` = sub-second fraction of the first request's L867 time; predicted throwing period from the first request = `max(0, M0 + s − t_first)`; observed = from the first request to the last throwing request.

### Reuse populations: exceptions by time since the first request of the repetition (100 ms buckets with any request; `exceptions/requests`)
